spoken_en.text: A is a subset of B

spoken_ja: A は B の部分集合 ／ A は B に含まれる
notes: A ⊆ B は A is a subset of B と読む。A is contained in B とも言う。

sources.title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3
sources.note: 5.2 Double Integrals over General Regions（D is a subset of R (D ⊆ R)）

sources.title: Oscar Levin, Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction, 4th edition
sources.note: 1.5 Proofs about Discrete Structures・5.1 Sets（A ⊆ B asserts that A is a subset of B）

sources.title: W. Keith Nicholson, Linear Algebra with Applications (Lyryx, 2021A)
sources.note: 5.1 Subspaces and Spanning（X ⊆ Y、X is a subset of Y）
